title: Product Manager
description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  

  

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**

**JOB SUMMARY**  

  

TriNet is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive the payroll product area within its HR services platform. This role sits at the intersection of payroll domain expertise and modern product craft — translating complex compliance, tax, and pay\-processing requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable product experiences for employers and their employees.


The ideal candidate combines deep payroll domain knowledge with strong product thinking and the ability to work across engineering, design, operations, and compliance teams to deliver outcomes end\-to\-end across the product development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the product roadmap for the payroll domain — from discovery through delivery and adoption — aligning with business strategy and customer needs.
* Translate payroll, tax, and compliance requirements into clear, prioritized product requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
* Partner with engineering and design as a single\-threaded owner to scope, sequence, and ship features with quality and on time.
* Drive payroll accuracy, run\-cycle reliability, and exception/error handling as first\-class product concerns.
* Use data and product analytics (especially Pendo) to measure adoption, identify friction, and inform prioritization.
* Manage the run\-the\-business (RTB) backlog alongside roadmap initiatives, balancing defect resolution with strategic investment.
* Engage stakeholders across operations, customer success, compliance, and leadership; communicate trade\-offs in clear, decision\-ready language.
* Stay current on payroll regulations, multi\-jurisdiction tax handling, and competitive/industry trends to inform product direction.

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\-10 years of total experience with 4\+ years in product management, ideally for B2B SaaS or HR/fintech platforms.
* Demonstrable payroll domain depth — pay calculation, tax withholding, deductions, garnishments, off\-cycle/on\-cycle runs, and compliance.
* Experience building or managing products in HCM, HRIS, payroll, benefits, or PEO/ASO environments.
* Strong product thinking: problem framing, prioritization, and the ability to balance customer, business, and technical constraints.
* Proven ability to write crisp PRDs/user stories and partner effectively with engineering and design.
* Excellent cross\-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfort with product analytics and data\-informed decision\-making.
* Bachelor's degree; equivalent practical experience considered.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with US payroll and multi\-state tax compliance, or comparable regulated payroll markets.
* Exposure to PEO (Professional Employer Organization) or ASO (Administrative Services Organization) models.
* Familiarity with payroll integrations — GL, time \& attendance, benefits, and tax\-filing partners.
* Experience with analytics tools such as Pendo, and discovery practices for B2B products.
* Prior work on platforms serving small and mid\-sized businesses (SMB) at scale.

 **Core Competencies:**

* Domain credibility — can hold their own with payroll operations and compliance experts.
* Ownership — drives outcomes end\-to\-end rather than executing tickets in isolation.
* Clarity — frames decisions, trade\-offs, and edge cases in PM\-ready, stakeholder\-friendly language.
* Customer obsession — anchors prioritization in real user problems and measurable impact.

**Work Environment**

* Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* This position is 100% in office.

Join the team providing financial solutions to over 3 million small businesses nationwide at one of the world's most innovative banks.


As a Product Manager within SMB Client \& Frontline Experiences (SMB CFX), you will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Business Banking capabilities that support banker productivity, client engagement, and relationship growth.

The Engage \& Deepen Area Product is responsible for capabilities that help bankers prepare for, engage with, and follow up with clients more effectively. This includes banker workflow experiences, client communications, content enablement, prospecting and research tools, meeting and engagement capabilities, and interaction visibility across the banker journey.


The Product Manager will partner across Product, Technology, Design, Data \& Analytics, Marketing, National Sales, Operations, Risk, and Controls to deliver integrated experiences that reduce workflow fragmentation, improve banker productivity, and create a more connected end\-to\-end client engagement experience. Demonstrated ability to leverage AI responsibly to improve analysis, documentation, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and product delivery.

title: Product Owner Platforms Configurations and Data Mgmt
description:
About Sanofi

  

At Sanofi, we're chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're an AI\-driven biopharma company, leveraging cutting\-edge technology and data to dramatically reduce the time from molecule discovery to delivering life\-changing medicines to patients. Our ambition is bold: harness artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern data platforms to revolutionize how we discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver healthcare solutions globally.

  

Our Team: Process Enablement Platforms

  

The Process Enablement Platforms team within Digital Tech is at the heart of Sanofi's digital transformation. We design, build, and operate the foundational technology platforms that enable seamless business processes across our 70\+ manufacturing sites, clinical facilities, laboratories, and corporate locations in over 50 countries. Our mission is to unlock value through intelligent automation, data\-driven insights, and world\-class platform engineering.

  

We're responsible for core platforms and products that sustain Digital Technologies and part of Business Processes, covering ServiceNow, Configuration Management Database (CMDB), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Asset and Hardware Management, and the data infrastructure that powers AI\-assisted IT Service Management. We don't just maintain platform, we architect the future of how Sanofi manages its technology landscape, ensuring every asset, configuration item, and service relationship is discoverable, traceable, and optimized for automation and AI consumption.

  

Role Overview

  

As Product Owner Platforms Configurations and Data Management, you will be a technical leader and hands\-on architect responsible for evolving Sanofi's CMDB, Discovery, and configuration data ecosystem into an AI\-ready, data\-centric foundation. This is not a traditional ServiceNow administration role, this is a strategic technical leadership position that bridges platform engineering, data management, AI integration, and DevOps.

  

You will lead a team of developers, drive technical excellence, and champion the transformation from configuration management to intelligent data operations. You'll work at the intersection of ServiceNow, Snowflake, Generative AI, and modern data platforms, building integrations via APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP), harmonizing data across systems, and implementing automation that challenges the status quo.

  

This role demands a proactive problem\-solver who can code, architect, mentor, and lead, someone equally comfortable designing and implementing data models, writing scripts, configuring ServiceNow Discovery and Service Mappings, and collaborating with AI engineers to build next\-generation capabilities.

  

Main Responsibilities

 **Technical Leadership \& Development**

  

* Lead the design, development, and optimization of ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM capabilities
* Architect and implement data integrations between ServiceNow, Snowflake, and enterprise data platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and application\-to\-application (A2A) patterns
* Develop automation scripts and workflows using JavaScript, Python, or other scripting languages to enhance platform capabilities and data quality
* Design and maintain data structures, schemas, and harmonization logic to ensure consistency across configuration, asset, and infrastructure data
* Leverage Generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, GPT models) and AI algorithms to automate discovery, classification, relationship mapping, and anomaly detection
* Implement DevOps practices for platform development, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated deployment across development, test, and production environments

 **CMDB \& Data Management Excellence**

  

* Own the strategy and execution of CMDB maturity, ensuring alignment with Common Service Data Model (CSDM) standards
* Drive automated discovery and service mapping across hybrid cloud, on\-premises, and SaaS environments
* Establish data quality frameworks, KPIs, and governance processes to maintain high\-integrity configuration and asset data
* Technically and processually lead Software Asset Management (SAM) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM) initiatives, ensuring compliance and optimization
* Define and implement data harmonization strategies to integrate CMDB data with Snowflake, data lakes, and analytics platforms

 **Product \& Roadmap Ownership**

  

* Define and prioritize the product roadmap for Platforms Configurations and Data Management in collaboration with stakeholders
* Manage the full product lifecycle: ideation, development, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, IT Strategy, and business process owners to align platform capabilities with strategic initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies (AI/ML, DataOps, AIOps) and integrate them into the platform strategy

 **Team Leadership \& Collaboration**

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of developers and data specialists, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning
* Organize and prioritize team workload, remove blockers, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality solutions
* Act as a technical point of contact and subject matter expert for CMDB, Discovery, ITOM, and data management
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Infrastructure, Operations, Security, Compliance, and AI/Data Science teams
* Drive change management initiatives, challenging existing processes and championing data\-driven, automated approaches

  

About You

 **Required Qualifications**

  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field
* Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with CMDB, including automated Discovery, Service Mapping, and asset management in complex, global environments
* ServiceNow Expertise: Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and CSDM implementation
* Data \& Integration Skills: Proven experience with data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), API development (REST, GraphQL), data harmonization, and integration patterns (MCP, A2A)
* Development Proficiency: Coding skills in JavaScript, Python, or similar scripting languages; proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation
* DevOps Knowledge: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated deployment practices
* Software \& Asset Management: Hands\-on experience with SAM and HAM processes, tools, and compliance frameworks
* Industry Standards: Solid understanding of CSDM, ITIL, and IT asset management best practices
* Agile Methodology: Experience working in Agile environments with product management principles (roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, sprint planning)

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Advanced Education: Postgraduate degree or certification in AI, Data Science, Technology Architecture, or related field
* AI \& Analytics: Experience with Generative AI tools, machine learning algorithms, and AI\-assisted automation
* Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP infrastructure and cloud\-native discovery tools
* Advanced ServiceNow: ServiceNow certifications (CIS\-Discovery, CIS\-ITOM, CIS\-SAM) or equivalent expertise
* Data Engineering: Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and modern data stack technologies

 **Leadership Competencies**

  

* Proactive \& Innovative: Self\-starter who anticipates challenges, proposes solutions, and drives continuous improvement
* Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Thinking: Ability to diagnose complex technical and data issues and architect scalable solutions
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaboration \& Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in global, cross\-functional teams across time zones and cultures
* Mentorship \& Development: Passion for coaching and developing team members, fostering technical growth and accountability
* Change Leadership: Comfortable challenging the status quo, driving transformation, and managing resistance to change
* Results\-Oriented: Track record of delivering high\-impact outcomes in fast\-paced, dynamic environments

  

Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary

  

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
description:
**Our Company**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You’ll Do**


In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.


Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.


Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise\-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost\-efficiency.


**Who you will work with**


On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next\-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.


**What makes you a qualified candidate**


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of product management experience, including 6\+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers
* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air\-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities.

**What you will bring**


* Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time
* Hands\-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e.g., Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud\-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).
* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.
* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance\-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next\-generation backup architectures, AI\-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise\-ready.

description:

Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.


This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. You will run structured discovery with business stakeholders to understand current workflows and friction points, then convert those insights into prioritized requirements and measurable outcomes. * Experience working with Agile software development teams.

* Release planning, product discovery, and requirements management
* Microsoft Azure fundamentals

* You are a natural connector, you build trust with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and keep them aligned.

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


ERP Manager, Operations Solutions \& Deli **Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)**  

  

There are no technical leads on this team. Everyone is a member of the technical team, and everyone stays hands\-on — senior people included. If you are looking for a title that gets you out of the code, this is not that job.

  

You will build across SAP ECC and S/4HANA, EWM, and TM, for around 4,000 business users. Extensions, integrations, data and interface work, performance. A lot of it has not been built yet.  

  

The work model for the role is: **Hybrid**

 **Reports To:** ERP Manager, Operations Solutions \& Delivery  

  

This role is contributing to the **ABB Installation Products Division** in Electrification Business Area  

.  

You will be mainly accountable for:

* **Building.** Hands\-on development every week — objects, extensions, integrations through OData and REST, and the work to keep them stable afterward.
* **Talking to the business directly.** No ticket queue between you and the person who has the problem. You sit with them, work out what they actually need, and build that — rather than building what a relayed specification said.
* **Using AI openly on the work,** and being accountable for the result. See below.
* **Shipping in small pieces, quickly.** Something small delivered this week beats something complete next quarter.
* **Keeping the quality bar.** Code review, technical documentation, design documents, recovery plans. Owned by the people who build, not enforced by someone else.
* **Security, privacy and governance compliance** on everything you touch.
* **Bringing other developers along** without stepping out of the code yourself.

 **How we work**

* **AI is expected, not tolerated.** The SAP world is conservative about this and we are not. Use assistants for development, debugging, test data, analysis and documentation — openly, and as much as they help.
* Two conditions. You own what you ship: *the model wrote it* is not a defence in code review, and we will ask you to explain generated code line by line. And throughput expectations reflect the fact that you have these tools.
* **Speed over completeness.** We would rather put something small in front of a user this week and learn from it than hand over something finished next quarter that turns out to solve the wrong problem.
* **Small team, high ownership.** Everyone builds and everyone supports. You will not be handed a narrow lane and left in it.
* **Honesty over polish.** Saying "I don't know, here is how I would find out" is a good answer here. Overstating what you have done is not.

 **Where this goes**

* The people who do well on this team end up understanding the business process better than whoever wrote the specification — and then they stop needing the specification.
* If you want to become techno\-functional rather than a career developer, say so in your application. We will put you in requirement sessions, give you process ownership as you earn it, and back you into that transition. We would rather grow you into it than watch you leave to do it somewhere else.

* 10\+ years hands\-on with SAP, with real depth in at least one area — ABAP, Basis, FI/CO, MM, SD or comparable.
* 3\+ years on S/4HANA, including at least one full implementation.
* Strong grasp of SAP architecture, system landscape and integration technologies.
* Demonstrated configuration and customization work, not only specification writing.
* Experience with modern integration — OData, REST APIs, SAP cloud solutions.
* Able to sit with a business user and be understood. This is a customer\-facing development role.
* **Valued, not required**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or a related field.
* Breadth across ERP, EWM, TM or analytics.
* AI experience outside of SAP world
* SAP certifications in ABAP, technical or integration areas.
* Cloud platform knowledge — AWS, Azure or GCP — and hybrid architectures.
* Agile and DevOps practice in SAP environments.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or finance process background.
* RPA experience and its integration with SAP.

---------------------

* **FinOps.** Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.

* Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
